name: Vigilo

indicators.context: User agent on every grey-box request Vigilo sends, set by its guarded HTTP client; the headless browser's requests go through the same client. Vigilo is a CERT-EU tool for assessing your own applications: confirm the test was agreed
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: User agent of the HEAD reachability check at the start of every white-box run that has a target URL. The agents that follow use curl, Chromium, WhatWeb and schemathesis with their own user agents
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: Echo probe header on Vigilo's grey-box root fetch and every crawled page, with the value vigilo<8 hex><e>. The header name alone is not unique; pair it with the value
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: Prefix of Vigilo's grey-box probe host vigilo-probe-<8 hex>.invalid, in open redirect parameters (https://vigilo-probe-<hex>.invalid/) and CORS Origin headers. The host never resolves
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: Token of Vigilo's server-side callback check (vigilo-callback-<8 hex>, with the negative control vigilo-control-<8 hex>), in the trigger parameter and the observation URL. Only in-scope loopback or private callback listeners are accepted
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: Default content of the inert file Vigilo's grey-box upload check sends (vigilo-file-<8 hex>, file name vigilo-<8 hex>.txt, multipart boundary vigilo-<8 hex>). The operator can set other content
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: Operation name of every GraphQL query or mutation Vigilo's grey-box agent sends (query VigiloInvoke ...)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Vigilo source code

indicators.context: SMTP identification greeting of Vigilo's grey-box network mode, followed by QUIT

indicators.context: Prefix of Vigilo's grey-box soft-404 baseline path /vgl-<8 hex> at the site root. Only meaningful with the 8 hex characters
